scope.unit: distinct original LOCKED A2-L15 card model reviewed

verification_evidence: Directly rehashed original source Memrise RAR a2ffb791c29ddaa43e27bb944f430bff6896dc3156115f8989eee3056d5471c1 and 9109-row CSV 52f8bb896f5aa1c8f878aeb0ea74ef07ddbeee75261af89dfb2fcad624fc1222.

Directly rehashed historical LOCKED v481 lesson15 ZIP 485b0545ec48f1e805eb918e68051be74ae1b7492fd68d11bbc70fc054ac45c8; 53 members ZIP CRC PASS and 52/52 SHA256SUMS, duplicate and unsafe path checks PASS.

108/108 original source row German heads, Persian raw definitions, raw German examples, lesson tags and media refs exact against registered Memrise export. 111/111 source-to-card edges closed and IDs unique.

110 new A2 cards + 1 reused prior A2 (ma2m-lu-0702) = 111; every card has 4 trilingual DE/FA/EN examples: 444/444 verified nonempty; all examples marked CURATED_PEDAGOGICAL, none claimed source-exact.

222/222 backend structured trilingual combinations valid; 220 show English in learner-visible details; inherited ma2m-lu-0702 displays two lines DE/FA only despite English backend translations. This is a real scoped presentation discrepancy and not a missing backend translation.
102/102 unique referenced MP3 basenames exist in original RAR; original rows 3579 3585 3615 3621 3641 3644 have no audio tags. Recorded audio speech correctness/playback NOT independently examined.

66 cards exhibit Man kann + Hier kann man and/or Oft kann man mechanically duplicated templates; 131 of 444 examples are near-verbatim variants of earlier same-card examples. This is a pedagogical diversity concern, not data corruption.

Only one false Persian full space after می/نمی, in protected prior A2 ma2m-lu-0702. Specific editorial issues include plural noun display die Fakten, source-head collocation Wahl zwischen diesem oder jenem, nonidiomatic legacy-like combination im Gegenteil zu + Dativ, and mismatched singular German Dieses Detail vs plural Persian translation.

Complete per-card model language screening: 69 editable A2 proposals (66 template group + 3 other standalone issues), 1 prior A2 presentation hold, 41 no specific action. No original source, historical LOCKED, active editable v011, A1, app UI or SRS writes. Historical L12 outer LOCKED bytes blocker remains unresolved separately.

key_findings.description: Repeated template examples with nearly zero new contexts; author better usage diversity separately
Two backend EN combination translations absent from visual details; one Persian می spacing issue; historical reused A2 authority
die Fakten, Fakten gives plural repeated as if feminine singular; show die Fakten (Plural), singular der/das Fakt
raw source Wahl zwischen diesem oder jenem; curated learner-standard preference zwischen diesem und jenem; preserve raw source
Kombination ganz im Gegenteil zu + Dativ less idiomatic than im Gegensatz zu + Dativ; review against Duden
English legacy-style combo please not to look should be please don't look
FA این جزئیات mismatches singular DE Dieses Detail
Oft kann man gegen Erdnüsse allergisch sein wrongly makes allergy seem recurring/voluntary; use Manche Menschen sind ... allergisch

next_action: Next A2-L16 complete sequential read-only audit. L15 language suggestions only to independently reviewed editable A2 successor; prior A2 display held. L12 original outer ZIP-byte conflict remains open, global C3 not import ready.
